newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota says to export new minivan models.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says to export new minivan models.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp will begin exporting two new minivan models later this month, mostly to Australia, Toyota president Hiroshi Okuda told a news conference on Wednesday.
Toyota launched the six- and eight-seater LiteAce Noah and TownAce Noah minivan models in Japan on Wednesday with a monthly sales target of a total 6,500 units.
Okuda said Toyota would export the minivans at a monthly rate of 350 units, including 300 for the Australian market, They would be sold under the names LiteAce and TownAce abroad, he said.

The new models were developed to compete with Japanese minivans like Honda Motor Co's Step Wagon and Nissan Motor Co Ltd's Serena, said Kazushi Iwatsuki, a Toyota director in charge of domestic vehicle sales.
Iwatsuki said the overall domestic market for minivans was 58,000 units in September and was likely to reach 60,000 by December.
Domestic orders for the new LiteAce Noah and TownAce Noah could reach 20,000 units a month in the initial period, Iwatsuki said.
